description: Land Aquisition - Atanwala Village, Laggala D/S Division, Matale District. (Amendment)
categorisation: This gazette notice deals exclusively with land acquisition matters under the Land Acquisition Act, specifically amending plot boundaries and ownership details for multiple land lots. It contains detailed information about land parcels, claimants, addresses, and extents, but does not involve government personnel changes, organizational structure, or any of the other specialized categories like legal, commercial, or public service matters.
